user.title: Log in to goma
user.description: goma will email you a 6-digit code. Logging in with Google or Apple is not supported, so use the email address of your goma account.

code.title: Enter the code
code.description: Enter the 6-digit code goma sent to {email}. Check your spam folder if it doesn't arrive.

reauth_confirm.title: Log in to goma again
reauth_confirm.description: goma has ended the session for {email}. Submit to have goma email you a new code.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach goma. Try again later.
error.code_not_sent: goma would not send a code to this email. Check that it is the email of an existing goma account.
error.invalid_code: The code is wrong or has expired.

abort.already_configured: This goma account is already set up.
abort.wrong_account: That code belongs to a different goma account than this entry.

data_description.update_interval: Minutes between reads of your goma lists. Press the refresh button to read them right away.

update_failed.message: Could not read the goma shopping lists: {error}
